name: Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API
summary: Open-access API for 470,000+ artworks from The Met, including public-domain images.
description: Object records with title, artist, culture, period, medium, dimensions, department, tags and image URLs (primary and additional). Public-domain objects (isPublicDomain=true) have CC0 images and data. Search lives under /v1.1 since 2026-10-01; the old /v1/search endpoint now returns 410.

rate_limit.summary: Documented limit of 80 requests per second per IP.

endpoints.summary: Search (Elastic-backed, paginated); note the v1.1 path

license.name: CC0 for open-access data and images

coverage.geographic: About 470k objects spanning 5,000 years of art

agent_notes: Search returns only object IDs; fetch /objects/{id} for each. Use the v1.1 search path (…/public/collection/v1.1/search) with offset and limit, not /v1/search. Check isPublicDomain before reusing images.
caveats: Re-checked 2026-11-11 with curl: GET /public/collection/v1/search?q=sunflowers returns HTTP 410 (retired 2026-10-01), while /public/collection/v1.1/search?q=sunflowers returns 200 (total 178; 153 with hasImages=true).
Many tutorials online still show the retired /v1/search path.

verification.notes: v1.1 search confirmed working and v1 search confirmed 410 on 2026-11-11.
